title: SwiftExplorer: Training-free Diffusion Model Alignment with Swift Diversity Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2609.06651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have general generative abilities but struggle to align with specific objectives. Fine-tuning can improve alignment, yet its training cost is often prohibitive. This led to training-free methods that apply objective-guided terms in sampling to bias the generation distribution toward designated regions, e.g., high-reward areas. However, these methods face two issues: (1) the strong directional bias narrows the pretrained distribution and generation diversity, and (2) indiscriminate constant guidance fails to prune redundant signals, hurting both quality and efficiency. To address the above challenges, we propose SwiftExplorer, a plugin that mitigates distribution collapse caused by excessive diversity loss and reduces compute costs. translated_title: SwiftExplorer：通过快速多样性探索实现免训练的扩散模型对齐
translated_abstract: 扩散模型具有通用的生成能力，但难以与特定目标对齐。微调可以改善对齐，但其训练成本往往高得令人望而却步。这催生了免训练方法，即在采样过程中应用目标引导项，使生成分布偏向指定区域（例如高奖励区域）。然而，这些方法面临两个问题：（1）强烈的方向性偏差缩小了预训练分布的范围和生成多样性；（2）不加区分的恒定引导未能剪除冗余信号，同时损害了质量和效率。为应对上述挑战，我们提出了SwiftExplorer，这是一个插件，能够缓解由过度多样性损失引起的分布坍塌，并降低计算成本。首先，我们采用继承-重启探索机制来避免过早收敛，同时探索也提高了获得高奖励轨迹的可能性。此外，它平衡……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SwiftExplorer免训练插件，采用继承-重启探索机制实现扩散模型与特定目标的对齐，在缓解分布坍塌、保持生成多样性的同时降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: SwiftExplorer is a training-free plugin for diffusion model alignment that employs an Inheritance-Restart exploration mechanism to mitigate distribution collapse, preserve generation diversity, and reduce compute costs.
